fields.FIR_Description: The reported incident took place on 2025-07-28 (night, 00:30): The complainant scanned a QR code shared by a caller who spoke of a refund, and Rs. 18,500 was debited instead. Arun Mani submitted the complaint online using the mobile number 9000000012. Transactions from the account SYN-ACC-100078, held by the complainant, were referred to in the complaint. Ramya Bai (9000000232) was mentioned as a person who was present nearby. A person named Hariharan Palanisamy, associated with the number 9000000463, was mentioned as potentially relevant to the incident. The complainant mentioned a bank transaction reference and transaction records. Records suggest a possible link with FIR-2026-00058, as the mobile number 9000000463 is associated with a suspect in both entries.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Suspect allegedly posed as an online buyer and requested payment approval.
fields.Keywords: UPI fraud, online payment, witness, mobile number, night, transaction record, bank account, suspect
